news.title: Trump says U.S. will blockade Strait of Hormuz after Iran peace talks fail
news.description: Trump said the U.S. blockade will stop Iran from policing the strait and benefiting economically while the rest of the world suffers from its closure.

news.title: Hungary opposition Tisza could win election, final opinion polls suggest
news.description: Hungary's opposition Tisza party could win Sunday's national election, two surveys showed, delivering a landmark defeat to veteran Prime Minister Viktor Orban.

news.title: ‘The Super Mario Galaxy Movie’ rockets to $629 million worldwide at the box office
news.description: "The Super Mario Galaxy Movie" is helping to power up box-office momentum before the summer movie season begins in May.
